WHAT THIS SERVICE COVERS

What we help you with.

We understand the unique challenges that international investors face when seeking to establish credit in the United States. Our tailored solutions and personalized support help you build a financial foundation while we help you handle the complexities of the U.S. credit system.

Scope, timing and fees depend on your individual situation. No specific score increase, approval, deletion, settlement, or timeline is guaranteed.

Situations where this may apply

  • check_circleInternational real estate buyers
  • check_circleVisa holders
  • check_circleCross-border businesses

Not sure this is your case? The consultation is designed to clarify which options are relevant.

HOW WE WORK

A strategy built around your situation.

Credit and debt challenges rarely come from one isolated issue. InterCredit starts by understanding your goals, reviewing the situation, and identifying the options that are most relevant to you.

01

Review

We start with your goal, the context behind it, and the information that may be influencing your credit or debt situation.

02

Strategy

We identify the services or actions that may apply and explain how they fit together into an actionable, realistic plan.

03

Guidance

You move forward knowing what the next step is, what to expect, and where InterCredit can support you.

No generic package. No promise of a specific score. A clearer strategy based on your situation.

CLARITY BEFORE COMMITMENT

Frequently Asked Questions

Have questions about working with InterCredit? We believe in transparency before you decide on any next step.

Speak with an Advisorarrow_forward
What happens during the initial consultation?expand_more

We review your situation, discuss your goals, and explain the possible next steps that may apply. The purpose is to help you understand the process before deciding how to move forward.

How long does it take to see results?expand_more

Timelines vary depending on the service, complexity of the situation, third parties involved, and other individual factors. InterCredit does not promise a specific credit-score increase or fixed timeline.

How much do your services cost?expand_more

Fees vary depending on the service and complexity of the situation. All costs are explained thoroughly before you make any commitment to a service.

Do you offer payment plans?expand_more

Payment plan options may be available depending on the service program. You can confirm current terms and eligibility directly with an advisor during your initial consultation.
